title: Notifications table schema and migration
description: Define the notifications table for in-app notification center entries, with support for read state, snooze, and project association.
acceptanceCriteria: FK to users.id with cascade delete
Optional FK to projects.id (set null on delete)
type ENUM: milestone_due, todo_due, milestone_completed, system

steps.description: Define notification type enum and notifications table
steps.details: Create server/src/db/schema/notifications.ts. Define notificationTypeEnum = pgEnum('notification_type', ['milestone_due', 'todo_due', 'milestone_completed', 'system']). Define notifications table: id (uuid pk), user_id (uuid notNull FK → users cascade delete), project_id (uuid nullable FK → projects set null), type (notificationTypeEnum notNull), message (text notNull), is_read (boolean notNull default false), snoozed_until (timestamp nullable), created_at (timestamp notNull defaultNow()).
Add index on (user_id, is_read) for the notification bell unread count query. Add index on user_id for listing all notifications.

steps.description: Export types and update schema barrel
steps.details: Export type Notification and type NewNotification. Add 'export * from ./notifications' to schema/index.ts.
Run 'npm run db:migrate'. Verify the notifications table and both FK constraints.

technicalNotes: snoozed_until allows deferring notifications — the bell should not count snoozed notifications as unread when current time < snoozed_until
Notifications are created by the reminder cron job and by server-side events (e.g., milestone completion)
